"""S13b: on the daily run the monitor also asks 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1 and 9.9.9.9 for each live shop's address and saves
what they say as evidence ("Reachable from 3 of 3 public resolvers"). Information only: one that disagrees is said
plainly and never alerted on; the shop's own nameservers stay the proof."""

import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import chain
from app.agents.checker import public_resolvers_text
from app.checks.dns_resolver import PUBLIC_RESOLVERS, Answer, FakeDnsResolver
from app.models import Alert, AuditEvent, CheckResult, CheckRun, Evidence
from app.monitor.scheduler import Monitor
from tests.test_m4_report import report
from tests.test_s9_phase1 import launched_shop

HOST = "meera.localhost"


class Broken:
    def resolve(self, name, rtype):
        raise TimeoutError("no answer")


def resolvers(ip: str, odd: dict[str, object] | None = None):
    """Three public resolvers that answer `ip`, except the ones named in `odd` (label -> resolver)."""
    odd = odd or {}
    out = []
    for name, addr in PUBLIC_RESOLVERS:
        label = f"{name} {addr}"
        out.append((label, odd.get(name) or FakeDnsResolver({(HOST, "A"): [ip]})))
    return lambda: out


@pytest.fixture
def shop(client, engine, settings, integ, claude):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email="meera@example.org")
    integ.mailer.drop = True  # the daily test order: accepted now, looked for later (not this test's subject)
    return biz, Monitor(engine, settings, lambda _b: integ, claude)


def evidence(engine, bid: int) -> list[Evidence]:
    with Session(engine) as s:
        return s.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == bid, Evidence.step == "public_resolvers")
                      .order_by(Evidence.id)).all()


# ---------- the plain words ----------

def test_three_of_three():
    seen = [(f"{n} {ip}", Answer("ok", ("1.2.3.4",))) for n, ip in PUBLIC_RESOLVERS]
    head, answers = public_resolvers_text("1.2.3.4", seen).split(" | ")
    assert head == "Reachable from 3 of 3 public resolvers"
    assert answers == "Google 8.8.8.8: 1.2.3.4; Cloudflare 1.1.1.1: 1.2.3.4; Quad9 9.9.9.9: 1.2.3.4"


def test_one_disagrees_is_said_plainly():
    seen = [("Google 8.8.8.8", Answer("ok", ("1.2.3.4",))), ("Cloudflare 1.1.1.1", Answer("nodata")),
            ("Quad9 9.9.9.9", Answer("ok", ("5.6.7.8",)))]
    head = public_resolvers_text("1.2.3.4", seen).split(" | ")[0]
    assert head.startswith("Reachable from 1 of 3 public resolvers (")
    assert "Cloudflare has no address for it yet" in head and "Quad9 still shows an old address" in head
    assert "no alert for this" in head


def test_a_resolver_that_does_not_answer_is_ours_to_say():
    seen = [("Google 8.8.8.8", Answer("ok", ("1.2.3.4",))), ("Cloudflare 1.1.1.1", Answer("ok", ("1.2.3.4",))),
            ("pretend Quad9 9.9.9.9", Answer("error"))]
    text = public_resolvers_text("1.2.3.4", seen)
    assert text.startswith("Reachable from 2 of 3 public resolvers (Quad9 didn't answer us")
    assert text.endswith("pretend Quad9 9.9.9.9: no answer")


# ---------- the daily run ----------

def test_daily_run_saves_it_through_the_proof_chain(shop, engine, settings, integ, client):
    biz, mon = shop
    integ.public_dns = resolvers(settings.server_ip)
    mon.check_business(biz["id"], "daily")
    (row,) = evidence(engine, biz["id"])
    assert row.check == "site_points" and row.answer.startswith("Reachable from 3 of 3 public resolvers | ")
    assert row.hash and row.practice is True  # the pretend world: labelled
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert chain.verify(s, biz["id"])["intact"]
        assert s.get(CheckRun, row.run_id).trigger == "monitor_daily"
    got = report(client, biz)["monitoring"]["public_resolvers"]
    assert got["title"] == "Reachable from 3 of 3 public resolvers" and got["agree"] is True


def test_quick_rounds_do_not_ask(shop, engine, settings, integ):
    biz, mon = shop
    integ.public_dns = resolvers(settings.server_ip)
    mon.check_business(biz["id"], "quick")
    assert evidence(engine, biz["id"]) == []


def test_one_resolver_disagreeing_never_alerts_or_fails_the_shop(shop, engine, settings, integ, client):
    biz, mon = shop
    integ.public_dns = resolvers(settings.server_ip, {"Quad9": FakeDnsResolver({(HOST, "A"): ["203.0.113.9"]}),
                                                      "Cloudflare": Broken()})
    assert "site_points" not in mon.check_business(biz["id"], "daily")
    (row,) = evidence(engine, biz["id"])
    assert row.answer.startswith("Reachable from 1 of 3 public resolvers (Cloudflare didn't answer us; Quad9 still "
                                 "shows an old address")
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert s.exec(select(Alert)).all() == []
        site = s.exec(select(CheckResult).where(CheckResult.run_id == row.run_id,
                                                CheckResult.check == "site_points")).one()
        assert site.passed  # the shop's own nameservers decide
        (ev,) = s.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.action == "public_resolvers")).all()
        assert ev.result == "differs" and ev.detail == "1 of 3 agree"
    assert f"recheck-{biz['id']}" not in {j.id for j in mon.scheduler.get_jobs()}
    rep = report(client, biz)
    assert rep["monitoring"]["public_resolvers"]["agree"] is False
    hop = [h for c in rep["run"]["checks"] if c["check"] == "site_points" for h in c.get("hops", [])
           if h["step"] == "public_resolvers"] if rep["run"]["id"] == row.run_id else []
    assert all(h["title"].startswith("Reachable from 1 of 3") for h in hop)


def test_a_broken_look_never_breaks_the_round(shop, engine, integ):
    biz, mon = shop

    def boom():
        raise RuntimeError("resolver setup failed")

    integ.public_dns = boom
    mon.check_business(biz["id"], "daily")  # no exception
    assert evidence(engine, biz["id"]) == []
    with Session(engine) as s:
        (ev,) = s.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.action == "public_resolvers")).all()
        assert ev.result == "failed" and ev.detail == "RuntimeError"


def test_real_integrations_ask_the_three_public_resolvers(settings):
    from app.integrations import real_integrations

    got = real_integrations(settings).public_dns()
    assert [label for label, _r in got] == ["Google 8.8.8.8", "Cloudflare 1.1.1.1", "Quad9 9.9.9.9"]
    assert [r._r.nameservers for _label, r in got] == [["8.8.8.8"], ["1.1.1.1"], ["9.9.9.9"]]

## 5. Our own shops: every check has a failure path (S11b Part 2)

No check ends in a silent "unknown" or a generic error. `gaps::test_every_failed_check_ends_in_a_fix_or_exact_steps_even_with_claude_down`
forces each of the 8 checks to fail in both launch kinds with Claude switched off, and requires an applied fix or a "needs you" with plain
steps written by code (stored on the check's row, so the report shows it).

| Check | When it fails | Doctor | If Claude is down |
|---|---|---|---|
| Address leads to the shop (`site_points`) | investigator → `repoint_site` (own-domain: `restore_backup` only with the owner's OK) | fix | the one standard fix runs |
| Padlock + the shop's own page (`https`, marker) | investigator → `retry_certificate` / `repoint_site`; a parked page fails the marker | fix, else needs you | needs you, exact steps |
| Mail servers / sending permission / signing / fake-email protection, shop under our domain | never written by code (they are our mailbox's settings) | needs you: "This one is on our side… our team looks after" | same text (code) |
| The same four, on the seller's own domain | `readd_mx` / `readd_email_auth`; another service's mail → explain only (section 3) | fix, else needs you | the one standard fix runs (`gaps::test_with_claude_down_the_standard_fix_still_runs`) |
| Test order: order form | "We couldn't open your order form…" | needs you, exact steps | same |
| Test order: mail server refused | investigator → `MAIL_SIGN_IN_REFUSED` (code's words) | needs you | same |
| Test order: inbox | "sent but hasn't arrived" / waiting for "Yes, I got it" | needs you | same |
| Settings unchanged (`settings_match`) | alert only: "If you changed them on purpose, nothing needs doing…" | needs you | same |
| Renewals (domain, certificate, team mailbox) | one email per threshold; the team card | needs you (renewing costs money: never done by code) | not involved |
| Watch-address | one email per new problem, explain only | explain | not involved |

| Situation | What happens | Test (`gaps::`) |
|---|---|---|
| **Our** DNS lookup fails during a shop check | "We couldn't look this up just now. The problem is on our side, not yours…": not passed, no fix, no re-check as a failure, no alert, an open alert is not cleared | `test_our_dns_failure_is_couldnt_check_with_no_fix_and_no_alert`, `test_authoritative_resolver_tells_no_answer_from_our_failure` |
| A shop uses up its time budget (quick 90 s, daily 300 s) | the remaining checks are saved as "This check couldn't finish in time, so we don't know yet": never passed | `test_a_slow_shop_is_recorded_as_couldnt_finish_never_as_passed`, `test_monitor_gives_each_shop_a_time_budget` |
| One shop's check blows up | recorded as "couldn't finish" in the audit log; the round carries on with the next shop | `test_one_broken_shop_does_not_stop_the_others` |
| Every outside call has a timeout | SMTP, IMAP, GoDaddy, Claude, DNS, page fetch | `test_every_outside_call_has_a_timeout` |
| A check is fixed 3 times in a day and breaks again | no 4th automatic fix; "needs you" with "This keeps breaking…"; ONE email "Something keeps breaking on …" | `test_a_check_that_keeps_breaking_stops_being_fixed_and_emails_once` |
| Fail → alert → fine → fail again, repeatedly | 1st: the normal email; 2nd: one "keeps breaking" email; then silence for the day | `test_fail_alert_recover_fail_again_sends_one_keeps_breaking_email_then_goes_quiet` |
| Our mail service is down when an alert is due | recorded as not sent, tried again on the next round, shown to the team on `/api/health` (`alerts_unsent`) | `test_alert_that_could_not_be_sent_is_recorded_retried_and_shown_to_the_team`, `test_watch_alert_that_could_not_be_sent_is_retried` |
| The checker's own HTTPS look meets a redirect to another host, plain http or a private address | refused; one request, to the shop only | `test_https_probe_never_follows_a_redirect_off_the_shop` (5 targets) |
| A practice shop is monitored | only ever against the pretend world; all its proof is labelled practice | `test_practice_shops_are_never_checked_against_real_services` |
| A shop the team paused | its shared proof page answers 404 | `test_a_paused_shop_has_no_public_proof_page` |

- Goal: show on screen what S11–S11d built; make "How the proof works" and "We keep watching" interactive; product photos.
- Asked Claude to: post a short plan, say first if anything was a bad idea, merge each part with `--no-ff`, keep every claim

  timeline, "Describe the problem" (owner route, 5/day, words fenced and not logged), incident timeline (report + shared
  page), a fourth staged fault (parked page) and a 4-fault demo switch, receipt + Verify. B: hop track and example day with
  "Something breaks", copy pinned by `test_s12_landing_copy.py`. C: product photos (`app/photos.py`, Pillow, WebP ×2,

  trace said "not allowed" (e2e); the landing's old `.hops` grid broke the report's hop line into a column (screenshot);

  inbox failures were given the "couldn't send the email" steps; "We tried 0 times"; a deleted item shifted photos onto the
